list: The official 55 PS5 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 27 visible, 28 hidden. Names and descriptions as published on PlayStation Network (Exophase list, read 18 Nov 2026, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueTrophies). Guides below are written in our own words; each names the source its facts draw on.
notes: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline. No online trophies. Cheats disable trophies and saving. There is no mission replay: keep a manual save at the start of each chapter (15 manual save slots). Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. Three trophies have no confirmed unlock method yet (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, Ten Pin) — their guides say so instead of guessing.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (PSN, as reported by Push Square / GTABase)
GGRecon — GTA 6’s trophy list is out, and the Platinum needs 100%

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Expect roughly 200 hours in total. The only step that needs care along the way is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude), the one trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and it unlocks. Nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 1 — it pops when you begin the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 2 — it pops when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 3 — it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 4 — it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4. It cannot be missed — finishing the story earns it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required (scan any 200 of 277 vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals), and you need any 70 of 80 challenges. The only parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable, and it is all doable in free-roam after the story. This is the hardest trophy in the set, so expect most of your time to go here.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely; flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find stunts on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, Activities to see which you have done. Most come up naturally through the story and the other trophies, so do not chase this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every shooting range challenge — 12 ranges, 42 gold medals in total. The challenges are not especially hard, and working on them also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, 42 drone races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest ones and skip the rest.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four video games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, and you can do this from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all the levels of any one game — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and is marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish all five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back to him. Kenton goes away temporarily after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), and everything is still available after the story. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish all five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward it. Confirmed strands that do count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, then drive it back — a car in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest), and once enough labs are down Tyrone gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down for good. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. You can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: there is a first meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house that is not marked as a spot. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you can accept and learn to meditate there. It is permanently gone after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — PowerPyx did it and earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). It is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, but finishing his questline is the way there. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida — pick any three sets and finish them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up then R1 to scan objects in the world — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges and you need any 50; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. Track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while working on the other trophies — leave this for late, then pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape in a fast sports bike; the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. An easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. You will also likely get it automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since large bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Also needs the partner free-roam unlocked in Chapter 2 (Coffee Break). Hit three robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix/Adrenaline). A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a few items in each, ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up for instant use) and scan vehicles with R1 — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this comes automatically. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline (L1 + Triangle) to stretch the window. Line up five enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets easier as you level up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — they stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door (which sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which introduces bank vaults: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier Payday Loans quests) and follow the purple van icons. Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) counts a vault robbery as an armored truck robbery, so it pops there automatically. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes automatically. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No reliable method has been published yet — PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach is the obvious place to try, but the exact bar, time or trigger has not been pinned down by any source I could find. Do not trust a specific method until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and the trophy pops (slightly delayed) once you are out on the street. Only the blue Banshee counts — it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and you do not need all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so you can come back for whatever you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always train together (call your partner with Right + Triangle); while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, select a character, Strength (heart icon). Fitness clubs are on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Your profile shifts through Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — the last one is permanent, so do not push that far. It happens passively while you work on the other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed method has been published yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Until a guide pins it down, treat any specific method you read as a rumour, not a fact.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it, and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed method has been published yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. That is a guess, not a confirmed method, so do not build a plan around it until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults (unlocked after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…) can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it — Ammu-Nation, mod shops and tattoo studios are the most expensive. Every shop type counts: clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, electronics, Pay 'n' Sprays and more.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to raise the cash.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you. You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
